label: first run, metric view + trusted SQL

genie.genie_sql:
SELECT `agency_type`, ROUND(MEASURE(`aa_revenue`)) AS `total_aa_revenue`
FROM `aa_demo`.`gold`.`sales_metrics`
WHERE `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `total_aa_revenue` DESC

WITH agency_rev AS (SELECT `agency`, `region`, `account_manager`, ROUND(MEASURE(`aa_revenue`)) AS `aa_revenue_2026`, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MEASURE(`aa_revenue`) DESC) AS `rev_rank` FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics WHERE `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY ALL) SELECT `agency`, `region`, `account_manager`, `aa_revenue_2026` FROM agency_rev WHERE `rev_rank` <= 5 ORDER BY `aa_revenue_2026` DESC

SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', `sales_month`) AS `month`, ROUND(MEASURE(`aa_revenue`)) AS `aa_revenue_usd`
FROM `aa_demo`.`gold`.`sales_metrics`
WHERE `agency` ILIKE '%Harbor Business Travel%' AND `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `month` ASC

SELECT year, ROUND(MEASURE(aa_share) * 100, 1) AS aa_share_pct
FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
WHERE agency = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND market = 'DFW-ORD' AND quarter IN ('Q3 2025', 'Q3 2026')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY year

SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(aa_share) * 100, 1) AS aa_share_pct, ROUND(MEASURE(fair_share) * 100, 1) AS fair_share_pct, ROUND(MEASURE(share_gap_pts), 1) AS share_gap_pts
FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
WHERE agency = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND market = 'DFW-ORD' AND quarter = 'Q3 2026'

SELECT agency, ROUND(MEASURE(aa_share) * 100, 1) AS aa_share_pct, ROUND(MEASURE(fair_share) * 100, 1) AS fair_share_pct, ROUND(MEASURE(share_gap_pts), 1) AS share_gap_pts
FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
WHERE sales_month = DATE '2026-08-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY share_gap_pts DESC

SELECT `agency`, ROUND(MEASURE(`share_gap_usd`)) AS `share_gap_usd`
FROM `aa_demo`.`gold`.`sales_metrics`
WHERE `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `share_gap_usd` DESC

SELECT agency, ROUND(MEASURE(aa_revenue)) AS aug_2026, ROUND(MEASURE(aa_revenue_prior_year)) AS aug_2025, ROUND(MEASURE(yoy_revenue_pct) * 100, 1) AS yoy_pct
FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
WHERE sales_month = DATE '2026-08-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY yoy_pct DESC

SELECT a.agency_name, ROUND(p.ytd_revenue) AS ytd_revenue, ROUND(try_divide(p.ytd_revenue,(try_divide(p.revenue_goal_usd * 9.0,12.0))) * 100, 1) AS goal_attainment_pct, ROUND(p.pace_pct, 1) AS pace_pct
FROM aa_demo.gold.agency_pace p
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = p.agency_id
WHERE p.sales_month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND a.agency_name IS NOT NULL AND p.ytd_revenue IS NOT NULL AND p.revenue_goal_usd IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY goal_attainment_pct DESC

SELECT `region`, ROUND(try_divide(MEASURE(`aa_revenue`),SUM(MEASURE(`aa_revenue`)) OVER ()) * 100, 1) AS `aa_revenue_share_pct`
FROM `aa_demo`.`gold`.`sales_metrics`
WHERE `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND `region` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `aa_revenue_share_pct` DESC

SELECT `sales_month`, ROUND(SUM(MEASURE(`aa_revenue`)) OVER (ORDER BY `sales_month` ASC)) AS `cumulative_aa_revenue`
FROM `aa_demo`.`gold`.`sales_metrics`
WHERE `agency` ILIKE '%Summit Travel Partners%' AND `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `sales_month` ASC

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT `sales_month`, ROUND(MEASURE(`aa_revenue`)) AS aa_revenue
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE `agency` = 'Sunbelt Vacations' AND `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND `sales_month` <= DATE '2026-09-01' AND `sales_month` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT m1.sales_month,
  ROUND(AVG(m2.aa_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY m1.sales_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS rolling_avg_aa_revenue
FROM monthly m1
LEFT JOIN monthly m2 ON m2.sales_month BETWEEN date_add(m1.sales_month, -2 * 30) AND m1.sales_month
ORDER BY m1.sales_month ASC

SELECT region, agency, ROUND(MEASURE(aa_revenue)) AS aa_revenue_2026, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY MEASURE(aa_revenue) DESC) AS region_rank
FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
WHERE sales_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY region, region_rank

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    `agency`, 
    `market`, 
    MEASURE(`aa_revenue`) AS `aa_revenue`,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY `agency` ORDER BY MEASURE(`aa_revenue`) DESC) AS `rank`
  FROM `aa_demo`.`gold`.`sales_metrics`
  WHERE `agency` IS NOT NULL AND `market` IS NOT NULL AND `year` = 2026
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `agency`, `market`, ROUND(`aa_revenue`) AS `aa_revenue`
FROM ranked
WHERE `rank` = 1
ORDER BY `agency`

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('MONTH', `sales_month`) AS `month`,
    MEASURE(`aa_revenue`) AS `aa_revenue`
  FROM `aa_demo`.`gold`.`sales_metrics`
  WHERE `agency` = 'Lone Star Travel Group' AND `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND `sales_month` < DATE '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY ALL
  ORDER BY `month` ASC
)
SELECT 
  `month`,
  ROUND(`aa_revenue`) AS `aa_revenue`,
  ROUND(TRY_DIVIDE(`aa_revenue` - LAG(`aa_revenue`) OVER (ORDER BY `month`), LAG(`aa_revenue`) OVER (ORDER BY `month`)) * 100, 1) AS `mom_change_pct`
FROM monthly
ORDER BY `month` ASC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT agency, sales_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sales_month) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sales_month) AS month_no,
         MEASURE(aa_share) AS share, MEASURE(fair_share) AS fair
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics WHERE sales_month <= DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY ALL),
below AS (SELECT agency, month_no FROM m WHERE share < fair),
isl AS (SELECT agency, month_no, month_no - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agency ORDER BY month_no) AS grp FROM below),
runs AS (SELECT agency, MAX(month_no) AS last_no, COUNT(*) AS months_below FROM isl GROUP BY agency, grp)
SELECT agency, months_below FROM runs WHERE last_no = 2026 * 12 + 9 AND months_below >= 3 ORDER BY months_below DESC

SELECT `market`, ROUND(MEASURE(`aa_share`) * 100, 1) AS `aa_share_pct`, ROUND((0.4 - MEASURE(`aa_share`)) * MEASURE(`market_revenue`)) AS `gap_to_40_pct_usd`
FROM `aa_demo`.`gold`.`sales_metrics`
WHERE `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND `market` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING MEASURE(`aa_share`) < 0.4 AND aa_share_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `aa_share_pct` ASC

SELECT a.agency_name, p.ytd_revenue, p.revenue_goal_usd, p.pace_pct
FROM aa_demo.gold.agency_pace p JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_id = p.agency_id
WHERE p.sales_month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND p.pace_pct < 100
ORDER BY p.pace_pct

WITH mgr_gap AS (
  SELECT `account_manager`, MEASURE(`share_gap_usd`) AS gap_usd
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE `sales_month` >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `account_manager`, ROUND(gap_usd) AS gap_usd
FROM (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(gap_usd) DESC) AS rk
  FROM mgr_gap
)
WHERE rk = 1

WITH agency_shares AS (
  SELECT agency, MEASURE(aa_share) AS aa_share, MEASURE(fair_share) AS fair_share
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE sales_month = DATE '2026-09-01'
  GROUP BY ALL
  HAVING aa_share IS NOT NULL AND fair_share IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN aa_share > fair_share THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_fair_share,
  SUM(CASE WHEN aa_share < fair_share THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_fair_share
FROM agency_shares
